text_block_list.text:
One day, while having lunch at a cafe, I
spot
Ikuno Dictus...
Can I join you, Ikuno?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Of course, feel free.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Geez, I've got some tough training after
this. I'm
going to need a hearty meal to
get through it.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Hm? Something up?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Please wait a moment. I'll be right back.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text: O-okay.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting. Do help yourself
to these,
if you'd like.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus brings over some salad and
side
dishes, then places them in front of
Найс Нэйчер.
Oh, um... What's all this?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I've observed you engaging in some
unhealthy
eating habits lately.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Hmmm, I guess I have been a bit lax,
now that
you mention it.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I believe you're lacking in
vitamin B1 and
protein as a result of
these habits.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Insufficient consumption of these
nutrients is said
to lead to lowered
exercise efficiency.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text: So I should eat what you've given me?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Yes. Eating these side dishes should
resolve your
deficiencies.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
To ensure a long racing career, it is
absolutely
vital that you continue to
consume the
appropriate amount of
these nutrients. Similarly—
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
I'll eat them! And very happily too! Go
on! You
should have some too!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Indeed. I'll do just that.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Phew. Thanks for the food! I feel like I'm
all
stocked up on vitamins now.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
You won't feel the effects immediately. I
believe
it takes some time for you to
absorb the nutrients
and—
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Come on, I was just talking about how I
feel. You
don't have to take things so
literally.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Actually, how come you know what I eat
on a
daily basis?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
You're my friend, so I take notice when I
see you
at the cafeteria.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Truthfully, I've wanted to offer you
advice on
numerous occasions, but I
didn't want to risk
overstepping any
boundaries, so...
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't worry about that! I
appreciate the
honest input. And I'm
actually not very good at
managing my
nutrient intake... or however you
put it.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I know! Why don't we eat together
a few
times a week? If you don't mind,
that is.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I'd like to learn more about vitamins and
stuff
too.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Very well. If you would tell me which
days work
for you and which ones don't,
then I can create a
schedule that suits
both of our—
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Relax. You don't need to be so
formal
about it.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
